Asia/Kolkata = UTC+5:30.  
US/Pacific = UTC-8.  
Difference = (-8) - (5:30) = -13:30.  

4:00 - 13:30 = (4:00 - 13:00) - 0:30 = (-9:00) - 0:30 = -9:30.  
Add 24 hours: -9:30 + 24:00 = 14:30 previous day.  

March 5, 1552 04:00 Kolkata → March 4, 1552 14:30 US/Pacific.  

FINAL_ANSWER: March 4, 1552 14:30
